ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white/light-gray pixels to low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: large contiguous white field with at least five distinct circular black spots of varying diameters. Right lobe: predominantly black with a central, irregular, high-contrast white mottled patch and sparse stippling near the peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an acute interior angle estimated at 25-30 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with irregular amplitudes; peaks are most prominent and jagged on the upper margins of both lobes, transitioning to smoother curves toward the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Upward sweeping curve with a slightly concave leading edge and a jagged convex trailing edge, terminating in tapered tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white clusters (barnacles) on the lateral tips and leading edges; multiple dark circular spots (0.5-2.0% of lobe width) within the white region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel diagonal dark linear marks (rake marks) clearly visible traversing the white pigmentation on the right lobe and lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct rake marks from predation or social interaction across both lobes; heavy acorn barnacle colonization on the distal fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Specific 'eye-spot' pattern of black circular markings on the left lobe's white field.
